notes: Ambiguous food words now lead with the US meaning but still include the other reading: "chips" leads with potato chips and still reaches french fries, and "biscuit" leads with the dataset's savoury biscuit rows and still reaches cookies; "double cream", "jacket potato", "candy floss" and "banger" now find the foods the US database files under its own names; This is a query-side word map in the search only - the food data itself is unchanged, and an ordinary food search behaves exactly as before; which food a word names says nothing about the food itself
